text.tspan: Access points, Multi-Region Access Points and Object Lambda
S3 Access Points (one bucket, many doors)
bucket policy delegates to access points
Each access point has its own DNS name (Internet or VPC
origin) and its own access point policy (like a bucket
policy) → manage security at scale, per team / prefix.
VPC origin: reachable only from that VPC, through a
VPC endpoint (gateway or interface) whose endpoint
policy allows BOTH the access point and the bucket.
Routes each request to the closest bucket (lowest latency)
Bi-directional replication rules keep data in sync
Failover controls: shift traffic between Regions within
S3 Object Lambda (closed to new customers since 7 Nov 2025)
Change the object before the caller gets it, without keeping a second copy. Use cases: redact PII for analytics / non-prod,
convert XML → JSON, resize or watermark images per caller. Existing customers can keep using it; AWS adds no new features.
For new designs you need another way (e.g. transform in your app or in a Lambda you call yourself).
